name: Nikkei Market Watch - Japanese Stock Market Dashboard

phase-1-research.title: Phase 1: Research and Planning
phase-1-research.description: Research available free Japanese market data APIs and plan the technical architecture. Key considerations: user is non-technical, must deploy to Vercel, prefer free-tier APIs.

research-data-sources.title: Research free Nikkei/Japanese market data APIs
research-data-sources.description: Find free or low-cost APIs for Japanese stock market data. Consider: Yahoo Finance Japan, Alpha Vantage (has Nikkei), stooq.com, or JPX (Japan Exchange) public data. Document rate limits, data freshness, and reliability. CRITICAL: Must work on free tier for non-technical user.

research-fear-greed.title: Design Fear/Greed Index calculation for Japanese market
research-fear-greed.description: Research how to calculate a Fear/Greed index for Japanese markets. Consider using: Nikkei 225 volatility, trading volume, market breadth, safe haven demand (yen strength). Keep calculation simple enough to compute with limited API calls.

define-architecture.title: Define simple Next.js architecture for Vercel
define-architecture.description: Design a minimal Next.js 14 app structure optimized for: (1) Vercel free tier deployment, (2) Scheduled data refresh via Vercel Cron, (3) Static generation where possible, (4) Japanese language support. Keep it simple - user is non-technical.

phase-2-foundation.title: Phase 2: Project Foundation
phase-2-foundation.description: Set up the Next.js project with Japanese language support, basic styling, and deployment pipeline.

setup-nextjs.title: Create Next.js 14 project with TypeScript
setup-nextjs.description: Initialize Next.js 14 project with App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Configure for Japanese locale. Set up basic project structure following architecture spec.

setup-japanese-fonts.title: Configure Japanese typography and fonts
setup-japanese-fonts.description: Set up Noto Sans JP or similar Japanese web font. Configure proper font-display for performance. Ensure good readability for Japanese text on mobile devices.

setup-design-system.title: Create simple design tokens and color scheme
setup-design-system.description: Define a CoinGecko-inspired color scheme with Japanese aesthetic touches. Include: market up/down colors (green/red or Japanese style), fear/greed gradient, clean mobile-first layout tokens. Keep it minimal.

setup-vercel-config.title: Configure Vercel deployment and cron jobs
setup-vercel-config.description: Set up vercel.json with cron configuration for scheduled data refresh. Configure environment variables for API keys. Ensure free tier compatibility (cron runs once daily on free tier).

phase-3-data.title: Phase 3: Data Layer
phase-3-data.description: Implement market data fetching, processing, and storage. Focus on reliability and free-tier API limits.

implement-data-fetcher.title: Build market data fetching service
implement-data-fetcher.description: Create a simple data fetching module that: (1) Fetches Nikkei 225 and key Japanese stock data, (2) Handles API rate limits gracefully, (3) Caches data to reduce API calls, (4) Stores data in JSON file or Vercel KV (free tier).

implement-fear-greed-calc.title: Implement Fear/Greed Index calculator
implement-fear-greed-calc.description: Build the Fear/Greed index calculation based on the design spec. Output a value 0-100 with corresponding label in Japanese (e.g., kyoufu, yokubou). Make calculation transparent and explainable.

implement-cron-job.title: Create Vercel cron job for data refresh
implement-cron-job.description: Implement API route for Vercel Cron that: (1) Fetches latest market data, (2) Calculates Fear/Greed index, (3) Stores processed data for frontend. Run once daily (Vercel free tier limit).

phase-4-commentary.title: Phase 4: Sarcastic Commentary System
phase-4-commentary.description: Build the entertaining Japanese commentary system that makes the site shareable and fun.

design-commentary-rules.title: Design sarcastic commentary rule system
design-commentary-rules.description: Create a rule-based system for generating sarcastic Japanese market commentary. Define: (1) Market condition categories (crash, dip, flat, rally, moon), (2) Commentary templates in Japanese with varying levels of sarcasm, (3) Random variation to keep it fresh. Consider Japanese humor styles.

implement-commentary.title: Build commentary generator
implement-commentary.description: Implement the commentary generation system based on design spec. Select appropriate sarcastic Japanese phrases based on market conditions. Include variety to prevent repetition. Make it genuinely funny and shareable.

phase-5-ui.title: Phase 5: User Interface
phase-5-ui.description: Build the mobile-responsive Japanese UI components.

build-fear-greed-gauge.title: Create Fear/Greed gauge component
build-fear-greed-gauge.description: Build a visual gauge component showing the Fear/Greed index. Use semicircle or dial design like CNN Fear & Greed. Include Japanese labels and smooth animations. Mobile-optimized.

build-market-cards.title: Create market data card components
build-market-cards.description: Build reusable card components for displaying: Nikkei 225 index, key stock prices, daily change percentages. Include up/down indicators and Japanese number formatting.

build-commentary-display.title: Create commentary display component
build-commentary-display.description: Build component to prominently display the sarcastic Japanese commentary. Make it visually engaging and shareable. Consider speech bubble or quote styling.

build-main-page.title: Assemble main dashboard page
build-main-page.description: Create the main page combining all components: Fear/Greed gauge at top, sarcastic commentary prominently displayed, market data cards below. Ensure responsive layout works well on mobile for sharing.

phase-6-integration.title: Phase 6: Integration and Polish
phase-6-integration.description: Connect all components, add sharing features, and polish the experience.

integrate-data-ui.title: Connect data layer to UI components
integrate-data-ui.description: Wire up the data fetching/caching layer to UI components. Ensure data flows correctly from cron job -> storage -> frontend components. Handle loading and error states gracefully in Japanese.

add-social-sharing.title: Add social sharing meta tags and features
add-social-sharing.description: Implement: (1) OpenGraph meta tags for rich link previews, (2) Twitter card support, (3) Optional share buttons for LINE, Twitter. Make shared links show the Fear/Greed status and funny commentary.

add-last-updated.title: Add last-updated timestamp and refresh indicator
add-last-updated.description: Show when data was last refreshed in Japanese (e.g., saigo no koshin: X ji X fun). Include visual indicator that this is not real-time data to set correct expectations.

phase-7-deploy.title: Phase 7: Testing and Deployment
phase-7-deploy.description: Test everything and deploy to Vercel.

test-mobile.title: Test mobile responsiveness and sharing
test-mobile.description: Verify the site looks good and works well on mobile devices. Test sharing to LINE and Twitter. Check Japanese text rendering on various devices. Ensure touch interactions work smoothly.

test-data-flow.title: Test data refresh and cron job
test-data-flow.description: Verify cron job runs correctly and data updates as expected. Test error handling when API is down. Ensure cached data is served when fresh data unavailable.

deploy-vercel.title: Deploy to Vercel production
deploy-vercel.description: Deploy the site to Vercel. Configure custom domain if user has one. Set up environment variables securely. Verify cron job is scheduled correctly. Document how user can check site status.

create-maintenance-guide.title: Create simple maintenance guide for non-technical user
create-maintenance-guide.description: Write a simple Japanese/English guide covering: (1) How to check if site is working, (2) What to do if data stops updating, (3) How to contact for help, (4) Basic Vercel dashboard navigation. Keep it very simple and visual.
